title: Strictness of the Planar L2 Rogers-Shephard Inequality for Centrally Symmetric Hexagons
scope: Strictness only for centrally symmetric hexagons at p=2; the original equality conjecture remains unresolved.
limitations: No claim is made for p other than 2, polygons with eight or more vertices, or nonpolygonal bodies.
The deficit has no uniform positive gap under degeneration to a parallelogram.
